canonical_title: Crew station environmental control system controls

versions.title_at_revision: Crew station environmental control system controls
versions.text:
Standard: Crew station allows the flight crew the ability to configure the ECS as required to maintain SCFs (e.g., manual cabin pressure release, selection and shutoff of bleed sources, and cabin temperature) over the air vehicle flight envelope. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review drawings, flight crew interfaces, and operating procedures to verify that crew station allows for the flight crew to configure the ECS as required to maintain SOF throughout the flight envelope. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct on air vehicle demonstration to verify that the crew station allows the flight crew to configure the ECS as required to maintain SCFs. Test.
    (1) Flight test: Conduct flight testing to verify that crew station allows the flight crew to configure the ECS as required to maintain SCFs.
